scope: Worker-only strict import of native input proofs in standalone and GUI runtimes, with independently expected context and request overlays
evidenceNotes: Native-v1 preserves a real -Werror misleading-indentation compile failure. Native-v2 recompiles109 units after the shared layout change. Private Unicode path byte-bound review then produces native-v3 by rebuilding only language_snapshot.c against identical final public headers/layouts and the exact full native-v2 cohort/archive. Final GUI source-v2 recompiles128 units against this same final service and matched SDK.

Native-import-v1 and v2 preserve fixture failures from a zero context allocation limit and a standalone context configuration field that violates the constructor contract. Native-import-v5 and gui-import-v3 use the final fixture and pass1321 combined checks each;757 are the included existing disk-reader checks, not additional new import checks.

Focused-v3 preserves a nested main macro compile failure in the new native roundtrip fixture. Focused-v5 uses explicit conditional test entry points and passes689 combined roundtrip checks plus418 existing candidate rechecks. Inherited export fault probes19 clone/248 consuming insertions are not claimed as exhaustive OOM coverage of the new importer.

Mutants-v1 raw batch remains failed: its first seven actual implementation assertion rejections are accepted; the subsequent constructor include override was behind the original include path, ran the unchanged producer and exited0. Mutants-v2 only corrects the override and verifies the remaining context/budget variants. Explicit acceptance composes exactly nine actual exit1 assertion rejections; no baseline execution, compile failure or crash is counted.

Final importer fixtures differ from earlier frozen unused test copies; exact final fixtures, actual source/header closures and each linked program are separately bound. The direct compile-and-link GUI import fixture has an additional explicit -MM closure receipt.
The final long Unicode path test checks overlay metadata/key acceptance, not compiler or deep project manifest support. Existing engine deep unprefixed xlp limitations remain.

Single-proof import performs bounded metadata cloning plus actual worker-side file/overlay validation. It does not approve complete compiler analysis, transport origin or request/model freshness. No whole-service latency/RSS or exhaustive allocator-failure qualification is claimed.
limits: Expected provider context must be independently established by the host, never learned from the same untrusted proof. Complete message decoding, scope/catalog association and method/ID/token/connection binding remain open.

Future Validate checks retained disk/resolution proofs; the host separately fences overlays, model revisions, configuration and lifecycle. Validation observes files sequentially, not an atomic snapshot or source lock.

7MiB is encoded admission, not a heap/RSS bound. Context/DOM/codec/allocator/OS and temporary work are additional. Full clone/hash and some platform helpers are not preemptible; all work stays off the GUI owner.

Complete transaction host/controller, physical publication policy, consent/recovery UI and startup replay, standard rename/applyEdit activation, remaining synchronous readers and final delivery remain open.
Whole-goal performance/resource/longevity, latest engine alignment, compiler deep unprefixed xlp path and analysis-configuration cache-count regression remain open.
C LSP remains disabled. No DAP/debug/runtime completion and no Linux/sanitizer qualification in this stage.
